title: Worshipped with Devotion
translation: Worshipped and served by the hosts of gods, with feeling and devotion, shining with the light of ten million suns: I bow to that linga of Sadashiva.
translation_hi: जो देवगणों द्वारा भाव और भक्ति से पूजित और सेवित है, और करोड़ों सूर्यों के समान प्रकाशमान है, उस सदाशिव लिंग को मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ।

words.note: dina + kara. In word numerals, a sun = 12.

grammar: -kara 'maker': दिनकर (day-maker), प्रभाकर (light-maker), भास्कर, शङ्कर. One suffix, many names.
Meter note: line 3 has 17 matras in strict counting, because कोटि before प्र counts as heavy; in recitation it is sung as 16.
Refrain: तत्प्रणमामि सदाशिवलिङ्गम् 'I bow to that linga of Sadashiva.'
